codes.name: config-file-not-found
codes.summary: The config file does not exist.

codes.name: config-file-unreadable
codes.summary: The config file exists but could not be read.

codes.name: config-file-not-utf8
codes.summary: The config file is not valid UTF-8 text.

codes.name: empty-config
codes.summary: The config file is empty or holds only null.

codes.name: yaml-syntax-error
codes.summary: The config file is not valid YAML.

codes.name: config-not-a-mapping
codes.summary: The top level of the config is not a mapping.

codes.name: unsupported-extension
codes.summary: The file extension is not one weevr loads (.thread, .weave, .loom, .warp, .yaml, .yml).

codes.name: schema-violation
codes.summary: The config does not match the schema, in a way no more specific code covers.

codes.name: missing-field
codes.summary: A required key is missing.

codes.name: wrong-type
codes.summary: A value has the wrong type: one code for every type (string, number, boolean, list, mapping), and for a value no member of a union accepts.

codes.name: invalid-value
codes.summary: A value is not allowed: not one of the allowed values, or not in the required form.

codes.name: unknown-step-type
codes.summary: A pipeline or hook step names no known step type.

codes.name: value-out-of-range
codes.summary: A value breaks a length, range or pattern limit.

codes.name: unknown-key
codes.summary: A key the schema does not define. Reserved for strict schemas.

codes.name: missing-config-version
codes.summary: The config has no config_version.

codes.name: invalid-config-version
codes.summary: config_version is not a 'major.minor' string of integers.

codes.name: unsupported-config-version
codes.summary: config_version names a major version this release does not read.

codes.name: unknown-config-kind
codes.summary: The config's kind could not be determined, or is not one weevr knows.

codes.name: name-mismatch
codes.summary: The declared name does not match the file name without its extension.

codes.name: reference-not-found
codes.summary: A ref names a file that does not exist, or a named weave has no file or inline body.

codes.name: circular-reference
codes.summary: A ref leads back to a file already being loaded.

codes.name: reference-outside-project
codes.summary: A ref or weave name resolves to a path outside the project root.

codes.name: invalid-reference
codes.summary: A ref is not a path string.

codes.name: missing-entry-name
codes.summary: An inline weave or thread entry has no name.

codes.name: duplicate-entry-name
codes.summary: Two thread entries in a weave have the same effective name.

codes.name: missing-entry-alias
codes.summary: A thread ref appears more than once in a weave without 'as' aliases.

codes.name: invalid-foreach
codes.summary: A foreach block is missing a required part or has a part of the wrong shape.

codes.name: foreach-not-supported
codes.summary: A foreach block appears where steps are not expanded (inside a 'with' sub-pipeline).

codes.name: warp-not-found
codes.summary: A named warp file is not in any searched location.

codes.name: absolute-path-reference
codes.summary: A reference is an absolute path or URI where a path relative to the project belongs.

codes.name: duplicate-weave-name
codes.summary: Two weave entries in a loom resolve to the same name.

codes.name: invalid-config
codes.summary: A config rule was broken, in a way no more specific code covers.

codes.name: empty-collection
codes.summary: A list, mapping or pattern that must have content is empty.

codes.name: conflicting-options
codes.summary: Two or more options that exclude each other are set together.

codes.name: missing-required-option
codes.summary: An option required by the block's kind, mode or other options is not set.

codes.name: option-not-applicable
codes.summary: An option is set that the block's kind or mode does not use.

codes.name: values-must-differ
codes.summary: Two options must hold different values but are equal.

codes.name: value-out-of-order
codes.summary: A range's start comes after its end, or equals it where the rule needs a strict order.

codes.name: column-in-several-groups
codes.summary: A column is listed in more than one group where each column may belong to only one.

codes.name: incremental-dedup-order
codes.summary: A deduplication on an incremental read does not keep the latest row by the watermark.

codes.name: name-collision
codes.summary: A name or alias collides with another name in the same scope.

codes.name: forward-reference
codes.summary: A name is used before it is declared.

codes.name: duplicate-column
codes.summary: A column name is declared more than once.

codes.name: undeclared-column-reference
codes.summary: A key or reference names a column that is not declared.

codes.name: cdc-requires-merge
codes.summary: A thread in cdc load mode does not write with mode 'merge'.

codes.name: cdc-requires-watermark-column
codes.summary: A cdc mapping with update or delete values has no load.watermark_column to order same-key changes.

codes.name: incremental-watermark-overwrite
codes.summary: A thread in incremental_watermark load mode would overwrite its target with each incremental slice.

codes.name: incremental-parameter-without-param
codes.summary: A thread in incremental_parameter load mode references no ${param.*} variable in its steps or sources.

codes.name: watermark-inclusive-append
codes.summary: An inclusive watermark with write mode 'append' can duplicate rows on re-reads.

codes.name: dimension-derived-write-field
codes.summary: A thread with a dimension target sets a write field the engine derives itself.

codes.name: dimension-write-mode
codes.summary: A thread with a dimension target sets write.mode, but dimension targets always merge.

codes.name: dimension-keys-field
codes.summary: A thread with a dimension target sets a keys field that belongs in the dimension block.

codes.name: scope-defaults-execution-ignored
codes.summary: A loom or weave declares defaults.execution, which thread-scoped execution does not apply.

codes.name: thread-execution-ignored
codes.summary: A thread declares an execution block, which is not applied at thread scope.

codes.name: weave-trace-ineffective
codes.summary: A weave sets trace: true under a loom whose effective trace is false.

codes.name: plan-failed
codes.summary: A weave's plan could not be built, in a way no more specific code covers.

codes.name: circular-dependency
codes.summary: The threads of a weave depend on each other in a cycle.

codes.name: conflicting-target-writers
codes.summary: Several threads write one target without being ordered or condition-gated.

codes.name: undefined-dependency
codes.summary: A thread declares a dependency on a thread the weave does not define.

codes.name: weave-not-found
codes.summary: A loom lists a weave the loaded config does not hold.

codes.name: missing-required-parameter
codes.summary: A required parameter has no runtime value and no default.

codes.name: parameter-type-mismatch
codes.summary: A parameter value is not of the type its declaration names.

codes.name: invalid-parameter-format
codes.summary: A date or timestamp parameter is not in the expected ISO format.

codes.name: unresolved-variable
codes.summary: A ${...} variable has no value and no default.

codes.name: lookup-key-values-overlap
codes.summary: A lookup's key and value columns overlap.

codes.name: undefined-resolve-lookup
codes.summary: A resolve step names a lookup that no visible scope defines.

codes.name: undefined-resolve-lookup-ignored
codes.summary: A resolve step with on_failure: warn names a lookup that no visible scope defines.

codes.name: undefined-source-lookup
codes.summary: A lookup-bound source names a lookup that no visible scope defines.

codes.name: source-lookup-outside-thread
codes.summary: A thread loaded on its own has a lookup-bound source whose lookup it does not define.

codes.name: undefined-column-set
codes.summary: A rename step names a column set that no visible scope defines.

codes.name: column-set-outside-thread
codes.summary: A thread loaded on its own has a rename step whose column set it does not define.

codes.name: unknown-audit-template
codes.summary: An audit template name is neither user-defined nor a built-in preset.

codes.name: undefined-connection
codes.summary: A source or target names a connection no scope declares.

codes.name: source-not-found
codes.summary: A source does not exist at its resolved location.

codes.name: source-probe-failed
codes.summary: A source's existence could not be checked, because probing its location failed.
